title: deepctl command manifest
description: deepctl/_manifest.json, assembled by deepctl/_manifest_build.py:assemble() from the per-command fragments in deepctl/_manifest.d/ (ADR-02, W3.2). $defs.fragment describes one fragment. Rules that span fragments (unique command paths, alias and tool names; a subcommand's group must have a fragment; an alias can't be a command name) are checked by assemble().

manifest_version.description: Format version. Readers refuse a version they don't know.

commands.description: Command path (the words after the program name, e.g. "listen" or "debug audio") to its entry.

aliases.description: Hidden alias (not listed in --help) to the command path it runs, e.g. "debug-audio": "debug audio".

tools.description: MCP tool name to the command path that implements it.

name.description: A command or alias name: the 0.4.2 plugin name rule.

path.description: One command name, or a group and a subcommand separated by one space.

dist.description: The distribution that ships the module (named in dependency_missing).

summary.description: The one-line help shown in the parent's command list (Click short_help).

deprecated.description: Click's deprecated flag: true, or the text shown after (DEPRECATED: ...).

group.description: Present (true) when the command is a group that plugins can add subcommands to.

fragment.description: deepctl/_manifest.d/<name>.json, or <parent>-<name>.json for a subcommand. Owned by the command's own changes.

group.description: The command is a group: an unknown dg <name>-<x> runs dg <name> <x> when <x> is one of its subcommands.

aliases.description: Hidden names that run this command (e.g. debug-audio for debug audio).
